title: Open on Project once setup is done, and move the Setup tab to the far right
story: Grillo used to open on Setup every time, and now does so only on the first launch or when a check fails. Otherwise it shows a brief "Checking your setup…" note and opens Project. The Setup tab moved from far left to far right, outside the scrolling tabs, and Project is now first. The update pop-up now also asks for the current offer, and two setup lines no longer say "company".

checks.criterion: First launch opens Setup; Continue with everything green stores the setting and goes to Project.
checks.steps: Start Grillo with an empty app data folder, with Claude Code and gh installed and signed in. Wait for every row to turn green. Press Continue.
checks.expected: Setup is the active tab and no "Checking your setup…" note appears. After Continue, Project opens and settings.json holds setupFinished: true.

checks.criterion: A later start where all checks pass opens Project and never flashes Setup.
checks.steps: Close Grillo after the check above, then start it again.
checks.expected: A card saying "Checking your setup…" with no active tab, then Project. The Setup screen never appears.

checks.criterion: A later start where a check fails opens Setup and keeps the setting; the next passing start opens Project.
checks.steps: With setupFinished stored, run gh auth logout, or put a made-up gh first on PATH that says signed out, and start Grillo. Sign in again and restart.
checks.expected: Setup with the gh row "Signed out" and Continue locked, while setupFinished stays true. After signing in and restarting, Project opens.

checks.criterion: A tab opened during the start-up check keeps its screen.
checks.steps: On a later start, press Tickets while "Checking your setup…" shows. This needs a slow check, such as a made-up slow claude first on PATH.
checks.expected: Tickets stays open after the check ends.

checks.criterion: The Setup tab sits at the far right after "+" and the agent tabs and stays reachable; Project is first.
checks.steps: Open many agent tabs. Scroll the tabs sideways to both ends. Narrow the window. Press Setup.
checks.expected: Setup does not move and can be pressed, the other tabs scroll, and Setup opens with its update card. Continue there goes to Project.

checks.criterion: The setup page says "your GitHub account" and no longer names a company.
checks.steps: Open Setup signed out of gh, then with gh not installed.
checks.expected: "Sign in once with your GitHub account" and "Grillo keeps every project in your GitHub account through gh."

checks.criterion: The update offer reaches a member who starts on Project, including a version found before the window listens, once per version.
checks.steps: On an installed build with a newer release published and setup finished, start Grillo. Press Later. Open other tabs.
checks.expected: The pop-up over Project. After Later it does not return until Grillo restarts.
